data.one_liner: In-app image and video picker with built-in cropping, filters, camera, and editing tools.
data.what_it_does: Provides an in-app gallery and camera interface for picking images and videos across mobile, web, and desktop. Users can crop, rotate, apply filters, make adjustments, and add markup before returning the files.
use_when: You need a custom-designed in-app gallery and camera picker rather than the system UI.
Users need to crop, filter, or edit images before uploading or saving them.
You need cross-platform support including web and desktop.
avoid_when: You strictly want the native platform image picker interface.
Your project cannot migrate to MaterialUiCompatibilityBridge or package:material_ui (required in v3.0.0).
strengths: Rich built-in editing features including cropping, filters, adjustments, and markup.
Cross-platform support for mobile, web, and desktop.
No native code of its own, minimizing setup issues.
weaknesses: Requires migration to package:material_ui in version 3.0.0.
Camera is not supported on web and desktop platforms.
data.setup_notes: Requires platform permission declarations in Info.plist (iOS) and AndroidManifest.xml (Android) for camera and photo library access. Version 3.0.0 requires moving your app to package:material_ui or using MaterialUiCompatibilityBridge.

alternatives.name: image_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the standard system-provided picker UI rather than a custom in-app gallery.
